fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-11-07 states that two persons allegedly entered Green Leaf Stores near Selvapuram Puram Main Street and took cash of about Rs. 5,000 after threatening the staff, on 2025-11-07 at about 10:35. The complainant, Venkat Pandian, provided the contact number 9000000236. The complainant is associated with the business Green Leaf Stores. Pavithra Bai was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Dinesh Prakash (mobile 9000000068) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Cash reportedly taken from the counter after staff were intimidated.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, suspect, mobile number, CCTV, main street, morning, witness
